comment: Per-object parity tier stamps, Phase-02 refresh (run 16). Tier = evidence grade of the twin object vs the reference board. Tiers are data, never verdicts: derived (measured from survey/DEM/pin/OSM), reconstructed (rebuilt from partial refs/analogues), approximated (coarse/inferred). Every loop-log run stamps every object. Retired stale old-twin entries are listed in 'retired' with reasons — never silently dropped.
